reader.requirement: At 85 the compiler must accept FUNCTION MOD with exactly two arguments (literals, identifiers or arithmetic expressions, space- or comma-separated) in an arithmetic expression, and refuse one, three, none, an empty list, and a table ALL argument (MOD repeats no argument).
